svg.title: Telling contractors the invoice address
svg.text: Most jobs sit on you or Pieter, so a contractor often has no Send invoice button; forwarding is their way in.
A. Tell them once, in your launch text
No app change: the address goes in the text you send each contractor when invoices go live.

g.text: Hi Zack, you can now send HG Capital
your invoices in the app. Tap Send
invoice on a finished job, reply to
the job email with the bill, or
When we pay it, you get an email.

svg.text: B. The launch text, and the address on Your invoices
A quiet line with Copy under the title, and in the empty state, so they can find it again.

g.text: Invoices you send show up here.
You can also email them to

svg.text: C. Keep the address for you and Pieter
Contractors use Send invoice or reply to job emails; only partners forward.
B's line: 'Or email them to ...' with Copy on laptop and tablet; on a phone just the address with Copy, one line down to 320.
A and B both use the launch text; B is the reminder for whoever loses the text.
C leaves contractors on jobs held by you or Pieter with no self-serve way in except a job email they may not have.
